newsitem.title: SPAIN: Ebro says Azucarera merger talks going smoothly.
newsitem.headline: Ebro says Azucarera merger talks going smoothly.

text.p: Spanish sugar producer Ebro de Agricolas said on Monday studies on a possible merger with fellow producer Azucarera were proceeding smoothly and that it expected to announce the results before August.
The two companies announced last December they had agreed to start talks on a possible merger which would create the fifth largest sugar group in the European Union.

Spanish newspaper reports on Monday suggested that talks had been stalled by a number of problems including demands by Saint-Louis' Generale Sucriere, a stakeholder in both companies, to control the new group.
But Azucarera said it was unaware of any problems with its shareholders or cooperatives regarding the merger, and that no agreements had yet been reached with anyone.
Ebro said it was still awaiting the results of a study by consultants on the merger and expected to receive them on Tuesday.
